bullets.text: THIS IS MOSTLY COMPOSITION, NOT CONSTRUCTION — and that changes the size of the ask. The chat window Akien describes already renders, is already declared by the librarian, and is already proved end-to-end through the shim; introspect()/active_page() already give a universal floor plus declared panes with absent-with-reason for the unwired case. What is missing is that chat is DECLARED rather than FLOOR, there is no verb set, and no presence answer that works without waking the device.

THE MEASURED TRAP: BaseShim.running returns 'an object was constructed in this address space', not 'a process is alive'. I-heartbeat-probes-and-bus.md:36 says each device is its own process and the shim is its process-manager; no shim spawns a process anywhere (no subprocess/Popen/fork). So a health surface built on today's running reports green for a device that never ran — the coin-toss-green failure, and it is why presence needs three states rather than a bool.

A CONTRACT CHANGE IS BEING ASKED FOR, and it should be seen rather than absorbed: active_page()'s docstring commits to wake-to-a-poke ('querying the page is itself a poke, so it wakes the device'), and 'a call to a never-booted device is answered never booted' is the opposite. My read is wake-on-WORK, not wake-on-ASKING. Named at birth because a silently-inverted documented contract is exactly how words survive while meanings are replaced.

THE BUS HAS NO LEGAL CHANNEL FOR ANY OF THIS. Its four are announce/personal/info/debug and it reds on an unknown channel; the librarian accepts only 'chat', which is not one of them. So the one device with a real receive is structurally unreachable by any envelope that can legally exist — already a measured child of mail-arrives-and-what-cannot-marks-itself — and a presence query over the bus inherits the same gap. It is the bus owner's call, not this node's to invent.

THE EASTER EGG IS THE GENERAL CASE, not a joke to file away. Scraps — the UU catch-all script device given a chat window it could not honestly use, barking at anything that was not a command — is the ancestor of the absent-with-reason pane already in the code. It says the chat window is floor for EVERY device, and that what a device does with free text is its own business: reason, echo an embedding, or bark.

Both are 'a component that is not a BaseDevice has no way to reach its own trail', and the floor answer this child builds — a trail scoped to a module address rather than a class address — is the same answer clause (3) needs.
